title: echium fastigiatum
intro: Echium fastigiatum, commonly known as the Spiked Echium, is a flowering plant species within the borage family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from coughs and other respiratory issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Echium fastigiatum include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it effective in soothing irritated throats and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
